cancellation_ledger.grouping_guard: Bare completed-square endpoint exponentials do not cancel pairwise. Their cancellation occurs only after each is recombined with its Fresnel tail into J_m and the complete symmetric roster is paired.
cancellation_ledger.half_current_role: The endpoint half-current is the finite-roster midpoint correction; it is not the canceller of the one-over-m pair current.
cancellation_ledger.low_partner: negative modes -621..-1 pair with positive modes 1..621
cancellation_ledger.outer_partner: negative modes -M..-39895 pair with positive modes 39895..M
cancellation_ledger.target_partner: negative modes -39894..-622 cancel the one-over-m currents of target modes 622..39894
cancellation_ledger.zero_mode_role: The zero coefficient is an explicit reconstruction term and has no one-over-m endpoint current.

next_obligation: Bound the single cancellation-preserving residual H+integral(f C_M)+sum_target(P_A+P_B), beginning with a grouped nonstationary B-endpoint enclosure and then matching the A characteristic part to the certified fold atlas on the same exact current.
proof_boundary: Exact finite symmetric reassembly, target/complement partition, symmetric residual limit, and one-over-m pair cancellation only. No quantitative joint residual bound, complete endpoint-tail theorem, ordinary/fold splice, complete T_upper, height-uniform theorem, Lambda<=0, PF-infinity, RH, or prize-level conclusion is proved.

symbolic_certificate.endpoint_values: D_M(k)=2M+1, G_T(k)=39273, C_M(k)=2M+1-39273 for every integer k, by removable limits
symbolic_certificate.one_over_m_cancellation: The Delta f_x/(2*pi*i*m) current cancels exactly in every finite +/-m pair.
symbolic_certificate.portcullis_to_fourier: J_m=(-1)^m integral_0^L f_x(u)exp[-i*pi*m(A+2u)]du=I_m because A is odd
symbolic_certificate.symmetric_limit: The proved symmetric-Poisson limit for D_M implies the C_M residual limit because G_T is a fixed finite trigonometric polynomial.
